summary: Iteration 77 — Inspirations™ Editorial Archive (Foundation Sprint). Tested backend router /api/inspirations/archive/* end-to-end (16 pytest cases, all passed) and frontend /inspirations page via Playwright (login, header, filters, grid, detail drawer + Market Resonance™, Add modal, legacy redirect, jargon scan). Pre-existing Mediterranean villa inspiration scored 95% Miami (passes ≥80% requirement). Newly imported test inspiration also scored ≥80% Miami. All taxonomy counts match spec (12/16/6/4/4). NO Pinterest Research / AI score / KPI jargon detected anywhere on /inspirations page DOM. Legacy /workspace/references redirects to /inspirations. Detail drawer shows AFFINITÀ CULTURALE with 6 markets sorted desc, italian explanation per market.

issues: Test-only artifact: an existing inspiration imported with a pinterest.com placeholder URL renders a broken image (no og:image). Backend fallback returns the original URL → card shows empty . Acceptable per spec (placeholder editoriale fino a sostituzione manuale) but consider adding an explicit CSS placeholder or 'fallback' badge when source_kind=='pinterest/instagram' and og:image extraction fails.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Add a visual placeholder for cards whose external image fails to render — currently a broken-image icon appears for unresolved Pinterest/Instagram URLs.

(Optional cleanup) Sidebar appears collapsed/icon-only in the test viewport — could not assert 'Inspirations™' label via text scan. PlatformCapabilitiesPage label change was NOT browsed (not on critical path). Main agent can self-verify by visiting /admin platform capabilities.
critical_code_review_comments: inspirations_archive.py is 595 lines — within the 700-line guideline but approaching it. Consider extracting taxonomy constants + _compute_resonance + _resolve_image_url into a /core/inspirations module if more endpoints are added.

Idempotency on POST /archive/{id}/links relies on a try/except around DB insert without explicit UNIQUE constraint check — verified working but could fail silently if the unique index is dropped. Consider an explicit pre-select-then-insert pattern.

_resolve_image_url performs a synchronous httpx.Client call inside the request lifecycle (blocking up to 8s) — for Pinterest pages this can stall the FastAPI worker. Recommend moving to async httpx.AsyncClient or background-task resolution with later patch.

GET /archive applies market/atmosphere/material filters client-side after fetching with .limit (rows are pulled first then filtered), so the 'next_offset' pagination semantics are slightly broken when filters are active. Acceptable for current dataset sizes; document if scaling beyond a few hundred inspirations.
